summary: Completed regression testing of the refactored course management app. Backend CRUD and payment validation passed; mobile layout/menu, student/class workflows, separate contract/receipt previews, camera permission fallback, and test-id uniqueness passed.
seed_data_creation: Regression/UI testing created TEST_ and UI Retest student, class, payment, and expense records; the app has no delete endpoints, so these records remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 covered dashboard/mobile overflow and menu, payment validation/modal errors, student/class creation, contract and receipt previews, camera denial fallback, and rendered data-testid uniqueness. No unresolved issues found.
rca of the issue: The first broad Playwright run reported two findings because get_by_text(...).first selected hidden sidebar text at mobile width; semantic main h1 confirmation passed, proving these were test-selector artifacts rather than product defects.
